en: The image shows a colorized, early 20th-century postcard depicting a grand building complex with red roofs and light-colored stone walls, typical of German architecture. The complex appears institutional, featuring a large gated entrance, with several people walking through. The text is printed in German, and the architecture closely matches German military or governmental buildings from the early 1900s.
